contentGuidelines.title: Content Guidelines
contentGuidelines.description: To ensure a positive learning experience for everyone, please follow these guidelines:

educational.title: Educational Content
educational.description: Focus on vocabulary that helps with language learning and practical use.

familyFriendly.title: Family-Friendly
familyFriendly.description: Keep content appropriate for learners of all ages.

noProfanity.title: No Profanity
noProfanity.description: Avoid offensive language, slurs, or inappropriate content.

noPersonalInfo.title: No Personal Information
noPersonalInfo.description: Don't include personal data, addresses, or contact information.

respectful.title: Respectful Content
respectful.description: Be culturally sensitive and avoid discriminatory content.

legitimate.title: Legitimate Words
legitimate.description: Use real words from the target language, not made-up terms.

contentGuidelines.footer: Thank you for helping create a positive learning environment!

boxDistribution.title: Learning Stage Distribution
boxDistribution.subtitle: Words distributed across Leitner boxes
boxDistribution.explanation: The Leitner system uses 7 boxes with increasing review intervals. Words move up when answered correctly and reset to Box 1 when incorrect. Higher boxes indicate better retention.

historicalBoxDistribution.title: Learning Progress Over Time
historicalBoxDistribution.subtitle: Word distribution across all Leitner boxes
historicalBoxDistribution.explanation: This chart shows your mastery percentage over time - the percentage of words that have reached Box 7 (mastered stage). Higher bars indicate better overall vocabulary mastery!
historicalBoxDistribution.stackedExplanation: This stacked bar chart shows how your words are distributed across all 7 Leitner boxes over time. As you progress, words move from red (Box 1 - new) to green (Box 7 - mastered). The growing green area indicates your learning progress!

empty.noHistoricalData: No historical data available yet. Practice a few days to see trends!
